prose: Bloomberg sources say Moonshot AI has closed its final private round at about a $50B valuation and is aiming for a Hong Kong IPO in Q1 2027 to raise up to $5B. Basis: the article is paywalled, so this relies on the headline.
highlights: Final private round at about $50B valuation.
Targets a Hong Kong IPO in Q1 2027, up to $5B.
